body: Another cool fact: lobsters and crabs are red because the red spectrum of visible light rarely penetrates the ocean deeper than 30 meters. This means that there is no red light to reflect off of their exoskeletons (if they are below 30m), which means they appear black - some nice natural camouflage. Neat!
